Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this nail-biter. The Windies have managed to level the series and the two teams now head to Warner Park, St Kitts for the decider on the 28th of July at 0930 local (1330 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye.

Windies skipper, Jason Holder says he was nervous in the last over but his team supported him. Mentions Bangladesh got off to a good start but credits the way they fought back through Bishoo, Nurse and Paul. Appreciates Hetmyer for his knock and hopes he continues the good form. Finishes by saying he is excited for the third game.
Man of the Match, Shimron Hetmyer says it was great to score a ton in front of his family and his girlfriend. Adds that he wants to take one step at a time and see how it goes.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza says he feels the total was gettable even though the ball was turning a bit. Further adds the way the seniors played was very good but they could have been a little clinical. Ends by saying the fielding was not up to the mark and they hope to come out better in the next game.

With 14 needed off 12 balls and 6 wickets in hand, it's always going to be an advantage for the chasing team. But Keemo Paul bowled an excellent penultimate over where he gave away only 6 runs and also picked up the wicket of Sabbir Rahman. Jason Holder who had a rough day with the ball then took the onus on himself in the final over when 8 runs were needed for a win. He dismissed the dangerous Rahim first ball and then held his nerve to bowl five quality balls to earn a thrilling win for his team.

On a pitch providing good assistance to the spinners, Ashley Nurse and Devendra Bishoo tightened the noose and also picked the prized scalps of Tamim and Shakib. Just when the game appeared to be in the balance, the 87-run partnership between Mushfiqur Rahim and Mahmudullah shifted the momentum in Bangladesh's favour. When the latter got run out, the equation was 40 off 29 balls which further became easier after the 48th over in which the visitors picked 13 runs.

After losing their way early in the innings, Windies managed to post a challenging total on the board all thanks to Shimron Hetmyer's ton and his century partnership with Rovman Powell. Bangladesh approached their chase like a train on fire. Anamul Haque set the tone early with his quickfire knock and then the experienced pair of Tamim Iqbal and Shakib Al Hasan took it forward. They raised a 97-run stand but it was a bit on the slower side which kept the hosts somewhere in the match.

Series is alive and kicking! What a terrific match! Windies have stolen victory from the jaws of defeat. Not for the first time Bangladesh have thrown it away at the climax. And not for the first time it's Mushfiqur Rahim in the thick of things. Remember their ICC World T20 game against India? It was going hunky-dory for the tourists but Windies maintained their composure under immense pressure and edged out the Bangla Tigers. Talk about choking and Men in Green.

No! Terrific delivery again by Holder. He angles it full and around middle and leg, all Mortaza can do is to hit it down towards long on for a run. Holder screams in joy and has his hands up in celebration. He gets mobbed by his teammates. Skipper has delivered in a crunch situation. Leading from the front, over and over again. Take a bow! WINDIES WIN BY 3 RUNS!
5 needed off the final ball. Mashrafe Mortaza on strike. Can he hit the decisive blow?
A low full toss on middle, Hossain heaves it through mid-wicket for a single.
Aerial...over point! A length ball outside off, Mosaddek throws his bat at it and slices it in the air. The fielder runs back as it falls in front of him. Two taken, 6 more needed off 2 balls.
Holder handling the pressure superbly. Executes his skills with accuracy. Hits the yorker mark, Mosaddek digs it out back to the bowler. Now, the two batsmen come together to have a chat.
Beaten! You beauty, Holder. He takes the pace off this delivery and bowls it on a length outside off. Hossain pushes at it and misses.
Mashrafe Mortaza is the new batsman.

OUT! Rahim is gone! Oh dear...heartbreak for Bangladesh. Disappointment written all over Rahim's face. A full toss served by Holder, Mushfiqur heaves it across the line but fails to get enough power behind it. Keemo Paul holds onto the pressure catch at deep mid-wicket. Windies are delighted. This game has turned on its head now.
Mosaddek Hossain is the new batsman. 8 needed off the final over. Jason Holder to bowl it. Rahim on strike...

OUT! Sabbir holes out! A juicy full toss outside off, tempts the batsman to go after it. Rahman swings his bat after going down on one knee but fails to get the desired elevation or distance. Hetmyer in the deep mid-wicket region makes no mistake. Is there any twist in the tale?
A low full toss this time, Rahim strokes it through covers for one.
Hits the yorker mark outside off, Sabbir squeezes it out to point where Lewis makes a diving stop. Cannot prevent the single.
Again a fullish ball outside off has been eased through point for a run.

A low full toss around off, Rahim shuffles across the stumps and paddles it down to fine leg. He rushes back for the second run, the throw from the deep is quite strong but the keeper misses the stumps while attempting to break it. Would not have made much of a difference though.
Too full and on off, driven square of the wicket on the off side for a run.

Edged? Maybe. But it has not carried to the keeper. A clever delivery, slower in pace and outside off, Rahim pushes inside the line and gets a faint outside edge behind. 13 from the over, the required rate is now down to 7 which was 9 at the start of this over.
Too full in length around off, it's hammered through the line and goes past the cover fielder inside the ring. They take a couple of runs.

FOUR! This is turning out to be the decisive over for Bangladesh. A shortish length ball around off, Rahim once again keeps his weight on the back leg and clobbers it down the ground for a boundary. Beats the desperate dive of the long on fielder. 16 off 14.

FOUR! Vital boundary! A slower delivery on the shorter side, an off cutter, Rahim camps back, allows the ball to come at him and then scythes it through the gap between short third man and point for a boundary. 7 from the over already, 20 needed from 15 balls.
That's a fine shot! A length delivery outside off, Rahim stays leg side and lofts it over covers. The outfield is quite slow and it has been stopped in the deep. A couple results.
Full toss on middle, Sabbir swings his bat across the line but fails to find the sweet spot. Not much timing as it squirts through mid-wicket for a run.
Uppish but safe. A full toss around off, Sabbir scoops it over the keeper who runs back. But the ball falls safely and they cross.

EDGY FOUR! Bangladesh won't mind it. Paul offers width outside off, it's served on a length and Sabbir swings his bat blindly across the line. It catches the outside edge, third man is inside the ring and it races past that fielder for a boundary.
Fullish and on middle, whipped through square leg for a couple of runs.
Well bowled. Keeps it very full and around off. Not allowing much width to work with. Rahim digs it out to point and crosses.
A full toss this time, around off, it has been smashed down to long on for another run.
Very full and on off, it's been driven down the ground to long off for a single.
Keemo Paul is back on.

Excellent yorker, around middle and leg and angling down, Rahman walks forward and fails to keep it out. It goes right through him to the keeper. Top over by the skipper, only 3 coming from it along with the run out of Mahmudullah.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total. 29th ODI fifty for Rahim, he is playing yet another crucial knock here.
Fullish and on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
A length ball outside off, driven straight to covers.
Full toss and this time it has been pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Sabbir Rahman is in next. 40 needed off 29 balls.

OUT! Comedy of error! Mahmudullah is run out after a big mix-up. It all starts with a shortish ball on middle and leg, Rahim is early into his pull shot but fails to connect. He is hit on his body and the ball rolls near the surface. Mahmudullah wants to steal a run and comes running down the track. Rahim initially shows interest but then sends his partner back. Nurse in the meanwhile attacks the ball from mid-wicket, picks it up and parries it to the bowler. Holder takes the bails off and Mahmudullah is not even in the frame. An unfortunate end to an 87-run alliance. Is this the opening Windies needed? Can they capitalize?
Jason Holder is back into the attack.

Beaten again! Nicely tossed up delivery around off, turning away, Mahmudullah tries driving it over covers but is beaten by the away spin. Just 3 from the over, Bishoo is finished for this evening. 10-0-39-1, brilliant figures for the leggie.
Turning away from the batsman, Mahmudullah tries to defend but is beaten.
Slower this time but the length is on the shorter side. Rahim moves back and then has to reach out for it. Still manages to hit it with the spin past the cover fielder inside the ring for a run.
Down the wicket he comes and forces his drive through covers for one.
Goes down forward and across before sweeping it in the air. It's in front of square leg and goes safely to the deep. A single taken.
Flatter and shorter on off, spinning away, Rahim stays back and plays it down to point.
Last over for Bishoo...
On a length and outside off, it's tapped in front of short third man for a brisk single. 11 from this over, 43 needed off 36 balls.
Good length ball on off, shaping in, Mahmudullah stays back and helps it through mid-wicket for a run.
Follows the batsman down the leg side and tries bowling a yorker. Ends up serving a low full toss and Rahim squeezes it down to long on for a single.
SIX! Wow, great wristwork and it has gone all the way. A slower delivery by Joseph, it's full and around leg, Rahim clears his front leg and swings it over mid-wicket.
Again it's very full and in line of the stumps, Mahmudullah helps it in front of square leg for one.
Too full and on middle, Rahim flicks it uppishly through square leg for a run.
Rahim goes on the back foot and punches it through point for one.
Eases a full ball down through mid off for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Not out! It's in fact off the under edge. Tossed up ball on off, spinning away, Rahim goes down on one knee to play the reverse sweep. Fails to middle it properly and the fielders think it has brushed his pads. They appeal as the ball runs away to the third man fence. The finger goes up as well. Rahim is quick to take the DRS and the replays detect the involvement of his bat. Since the umpire had given that out, it became a dead ball. No runs allotted. A bit unfortunate.
Shout for an lbw! The finger has gone up but Rahim immediately takes the DRS indicating that he has gloved it. We thought the same. Let's see...
This one stays low. Short and around off, spinning away, Rahim tries to pull but it goes under his bat.
Flighted full ball on off, driven down the ground to long off for a run.
Devendra Bishoo is back on.
Slower delivery, on a length around off, Rahim plays it late and dabs it towards short third man. Dot ball to end the over, 8 coming off it.
A low full toss on off, it's been tucked through square leg for a run.
Yorker around leg, tailing down, Rahim tries to keep it out but misses. It goes off his boot to point and Rahim limps across to the other end for a leg bye.
FOUR! Shot! Back of a length ball around off, angling in, Rahim swivels on the back leg and pulls it thunderously through long leg for a cracking boundary.
Wide! Full and sliding down the leg side, Rahim tries his best to flick but misses.
Good length ball on middle, Mahmudullah glances it through square leg for a run.
Short and on off, 140 kph, Mahmudullah goes on his toes and pulls it towards short fine leg. Lucky to get away with that. Either side of that fielder and that would have been a boundary.
Pace from both ends now. Alzarri Joseph to operate from the other end.

FOUR! The extra ball in the over has cost Paul. Rahim with the innovative shot. Moves across the stumps to a length ball and spoons it over the keeper's head for a boundary. 10 from the over, 66 needed more.
A length delivery outside off, hit square of the wicket on the off side for one. Not much pressure being applied on Bangladesh at the moment and this game is drifting away from Windies.
Forces a full ball down through mid on for a single.
Tries to hit the yorker mark but ends up slipping a low full toss on off, Mahmudullah eases it through mid-wicket and crosses.
Slower delivery this time, outside off and curving away. Rahim picks it and calmly guides it down to third man for a run.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and bunts it through mid on. Runs the first run hard but that's all they will get.
Wide! Full and drifting down the leg side, Mahmudullah tries flicking but misses. The keeper tries to put off the umpire by appealing for a catch but fails to succeed in his plan. A wide signalled.
Powerplay 3 signalled. Maximum 5 fielders allowed outside the ring now. There is a bowling change too. Keemo Paul returns in the attack. 76 needed off 60 balls.
Just short of short fine leg. Flatter and shorter on middle, Rahim goes back to pull but fails to middle properly. It goes on one drop to Joseph.
Moves deep inside the crease and works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Full toss on middle, forced down to long on for a run. 50-run stand comes up. This pair has kept Bangladesh on track.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Miscommunication but no harm done. Tossed up ball on leg, Rahim helps it towards short fine leg and his partner looks for a run. He is sent back immediately as Joseph releases his throw at the bowler's end. Mahmudullah dives to make it in safely as the throw misses the target.
Turns it off his pads towards the left side of the short fine leg fielder for a run.
Flighted full ball on off, Rahim drills his drive through covers. Jason Mohammed in the deep makes a diving stop and saves two runs for his team. Every run matters. 12 off this over.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for one.
Tossed up ball on off, driven square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.

SIX! Stunning shot! That has gone all the way. A delivery landing full around leg and spinning away, Mahmudullah makes space and lofts it nonchalantly over a leaping wide long off fielder for a biggie.
Flighted full ball on off, Rahim sweeps it in front of square leg for a single.
This one is on the shorter side. Rahim with the spin hits it behind square leg for another single. 7 from the over, 91 needed off 72 balls. This is getting close.
Tickles it off his pads in front of square leg and rotates the strike.
Short and on off, cut off the back foot through point for a single.

FOUR! Much-needed one! Short delivery, on middle and leg, spinning down, Rahim goes deep inside the crease and hammers it to deep backward square leg for a boundary, beating the diving effort in the deep.
Gets on the front foot and drives it through the line. Gayle sticks his right boot and stops the ball.
Walks down the track and yorks himself. Ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Floats it up on off, Rahim with the turn lofts it towards long off for a single.
Flatter on off, Mahmudullah punches it through the off side for a run.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.

DROPPED! Gayle is the culprit. Has he probably dropped the game? We will have to wait to find out. A brilliantly bowled leg spinner. It is tossed up on off, which means the batsman has to play at it which Mahmudullah does as he tries to defend. It then pitches and turns away, takes the outside edge and goes low towards first slip. The big man there cannot get down quickly as he gets his hands to it but can't hang on. Bishoo has his hands on his head and so do the other Windies players.
Floats it up on leg stump, the ball turns, takes the leading edge and lands safe over covers for a brace.
A dot to end the over! Just 5 from it. Rahim finds the fielder at mid-wicket with the flick.
5 singles from 5 balls. Another quicker ball on middle, Mahmudullah clips it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Fires it on the pads, Rahim nudges it around the corner for another run.
Flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Floats it up on middle, Rahim with the turn works it to mid-wicket for a run.
Starts with a short one on the pads, Mahmudullah pulls it but finds deep backward square leg. Only a run taken. The batter will be disappointed he did not put that away.
Chris Gayle is back into the attack.
Play and a miss! Nicely flighted leg spinner landing around off and turning away, Rahim lunges to defend but it spins past his bat in a jiffy.
Works it off his pads in front of square leg for one.
Quicker this time, Mahmudullah tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It pops out off the leading edge but goes safely towards the cover region.
Beaten! Extra flight on this one. It lands full and wide outside off, Mahmudullah tries going inside-out over covers but is beaten for turn and bounce.
Rocks on the back foot to a short ball, fetches it from outside off and drags his pull shot past mid on for a run.
Loopy and full on off, Mahmudullah quietly plays it in the gap at mid-wicket for a quick single.
Drinks!

Down the leg side, Mahmudullah flicks it towards short fine leg for a run. End of his spell. His figures reads 10-0-34-1. Brilliant by the offie. Another 110 needed in 16 overs with 7 wickets in hand.
Outside off, turning into the batsman. Mahmudullah goes back and guides it to the fielder at first slip.
Tucks it to mid-wicket with the turn.

Flatter outside off, this one turns back in shaprly. Rahim goes back to work it on the leg side but does not connect. The ball hits him high on the pads and goes towards short third man for a run. A leg bye signaled.
Floats it up on off, Rahim prods forward to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.

Uppish but just wide of short mid-wicket. Mahmudullah is happy to go after the off spinner. He once again goes for the slog sweep but the ball goes off the inner half towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
Floats it on the stumps, Rahim goes down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Quicker this time on off, Rahim defends it.
Again, lovely bowling. Flighted ball outside off, Rahim stretches and tries to defend but is beaten by the away turn.

BEAUTY! Loopy ball on off, tempting the batsman to drive. Mahmudullah does go for it but the ball pitches and turns. Beats the outside edge of the batsman. The keeper also fails to collect it and the batsmen run a bye.
Flatter on off, Mahmudullah goes back and defends it.
Rahim prods forward and keeps the ball out off the front foot. 8 from the over, a good one for Bangladesh. 116 more needed from 18 overs.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
And again! Another straighter one outside off, Mahmudullah lunges and tries to keep it out but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
The slider outside off, Mahmudullah plays for the turn but gets beaten.
WIDE! Down the leg side and the umpire has wided it.
SIX! BANG! That should break the shackles! Brilliant shot. Mahmudullah goes down on one knee and with the turn, slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence. 118 more needed.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Goes deep inside the crease and reads the googly late. Somehow manages to keep it out in the gap at covers and crosses. 2 from the over, a lovely over by Bishoo.
Short this time, outside off and whizzing off the surface, Mahmudullah is beaten for pace as he tries to cut.
Gets bat on ball finally. Manages to tap it down with the spin to point.
Once again it's turning away, Mahmudullah tries defending but is beaten by the away spin.
Quicker and spinning away outside off, Mahmudullah plays inside the line and misses.
Knocks a full ball down through mid on for a run.

Another appeal but not given! Floats it up on off, this also turns back in sharply. Mahmudullah tries to defend but the ball hits him on the pads. The keeper dives forward to take it. He appeals but the umpire stays put.
Works it around the corner with the turn.

NOT OUT! Missing leg! I did not see that coming. Excellent use of the review once again by Bangladesh. The off spinner by Nurse outside off, Mahmudullah shuffles across and tries to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire does not hesitate to raise the finger. Mahmudullah straightaway goes for the review and the replays show that the ball is spinning past the leg stump. He too survives and happy faces in the Bangladeshi camp as they are pleased after watching the replays.
The straighter one outside off, Mahmudullah plays for the turn but gets beaten. Lovely bowling this from Nurse.
Mahmudullah has been given LBW now! He though signals the 'T'. Inside edge? Well if there is not one, he seems a goner.
WIDE! Down the leg side and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Mahmudullah is the new man in.

OUT! GONE! Once again the bowling change does the trick for the Windies. The pressure of the required run rate has got to Shakib and he perishes trying to go for some quick runs. He makes room and Nurse fires this full and outside off. Shakib reaches out for it as he tries to hit it through the off side but he ends up slicing it towards the man at backward point. Keemo Paul there accepts an easy catch. Both the set batsmen are now in the hut which makes things very interesting.
Works it around the corner with the turn for a run.
Ashley Nurse is back on.
Quicker and outside off, Shakib slaps it through covers and gets a brace.
Floats it up on middle, Shakib hits it hard towards mid on.
Strokes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Goes for the sweep again but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Flatter on off, Rahim guides it to point.

NOT OUT! The foot is grounded! Rahim once again goes for the sweep shot but misses by a long way as the ball turns away. The keeper collects it and dislodges the bails. He appeals and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show that Rahim's foot is inside the crease.
An appeal for a stumping has been taken to the third umpire. Rahim is the man in question.
FOUR! And here comes the pressure releaser. A big heave-ho by Shakib. It's on a length around off and the Bangla superstar swings it over mid-wicket. A boundary results.
Finds the yorker mark, Shakib jams it out. Pressure building as the striker is not able to rotate the strike.
Keeps it full and outside off this time, it's driven through the line but once again straight towards mid off.
Runs in and angles in a very full ball on off, Shakib digs it out and Holder moves across to his left to stop the ball.
Fullish and on off, pushed down to mid off.
Plays it late and dabs it down to third man for a run.

Safe! The ball has bounced! Shakib thinks out about going big as he uses his feet. He tries to go downtown but gets an inside edge which seems to have bounced before hitting his boot. The ball lobs towards mid-wicket where Hetmyer dives forward and takes it. The players appeal and the umpires go upstairs to check. Replays show that it has bounced. End of an action-packed over. 3 runs and there could have been a wicket had it not been for the review. Nevertheless, Bishoo is causing a lot of problems.
Drama once again! This time an appeal for a catch has been referred by the umpires. The question is, has Shakib hit the ball onto his foot or has it bounced before hitting his foot?

NOT OUT! It is missing the leg pole. The Bangladeshi dressing room breathes a sigh of relief as Shakib lives to fight another day. Bishoo tosses it up on middle and this one turns back in after landing. Shakib tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire agrees. Shakib looks at his partner and then goes for the review. Replays roll in and they show there is no bat involved. Time for the Hawk Eye now and it shows the ball to be doing too much. It is missing leg. Brilliant use of the technology.
Shakib's a goner. He has been adjudged LBW but he wants it to be taken upstairs. Looks out to the naked eye.

Fifty for Shakib now. Consecutive ones for him. This time though he would not want to miss out on a ton. He goes back and guides it through backward point. Some good running by the two helps them run a brace.
On middle, turning back in. Shakib tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Sweeps it towards deep square leg for a run. Rahim's get out of trouble shot.

A huge shout but not given! Also, no reviews available for the Windies. Bishoo tosses it up around the leg pole. The ball pitches and then turns a lot. Rahim tries to defend but the ball beats the outside edge and hits his pads. The players appeal but the umpire remains put. Pitching outside leg I feel. Yes, Hawk Eye proves me right.
Fuller in length on off, Rahim strokes it through covers and takes a run. He gets off the mark.
Hits the length hard on off, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
A slower ball outside off, Shakib drives it towards sweeper cover for a run.
A yorker outside off, Shakib tries to jam it out but misses.
Good length again on off, the batsman keeps it out.
Hits the length hard on off, Shakib defends it onto the ground.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! Stumped! No consecutive tons for Tamim, no consecutive hundred-run stand between him and Shakib. The Windies have got the much-needed breakthrough. It is Bishoo who strikes on the last ball of his first over. Excellent bowling change. Tamim loses his patience and comes down the track, goes for the hoick but he is nowhere close to the pitch of the ball. He misses as the ball turns back in, the keeper collects it and whips the bails off. The Windies are delighted as they are now back in the game. 143 more needed.
Tries to sweep but gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg.
Eases it down to long off for a run.
A low full toss, Shakib flicks but finds the man at mid-wicket.
On the shorter side on middle, Shakib flat-bats it back to the bowler.
Dances down the track on the very first ball. Tries to whip it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Devendra Bishoo is into the attack.

Lovely stop! Jason Mohammed is the man. Saves a boundary. A low full toss on off, Shakib gets it off the middle towards wide mid off. Jason dives there to his right and stops it with one hand. A run taken.
Fuller on leg stump, Tamim strokes it down to long on for an easy single. The stand is now worth 95.
A yorker on off, Tamim jams it out to point.
Slower and short ball outside off, Tamim cuts it hard but finds the man at point.
Tucks it through mid-wicket with the angle for a run.
Swing and an edge but a single! Tamim dances down the track and tries to whack it. He only gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Uses his feet and also makes room. He tries to go inside out but Gayle follows him by firing it on his pads. Tamim tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Almost! On middle and this one pitches and turns. The batsman goes back and tries defend but gets an outside edge towards point.
Flatter on middle, punched back to the bowler.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.

On the pads, Tamim tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg as the keeper appeals. The umpire shakes his head and then signals leg bye as the batsmen cross.
On the pads, Shakib tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Good shot! Full and on middle, Shakib lofts it over the bowler's head and takes two.
Fuller in length on off, Tamim drives it through covers for a run.
Just behind a length on middle, Shakib punches it down towards mid on for a run.
Fuller in length on middle, driven back to the bowler.
On the shorter side, Shakib tries to cut but gets an inside edge onto the ground.
On the stumps and kept out.
Daces down the track and Gayle shortens the length. Iqbal defends.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
50 for Tamim, he follows his ton from the last game with a half century in this one. He is not done yet. Strokes this to long on and gets to the other end. Raises his bat to acknowledge the applause.

FOUR! Shouldn't have been one! Poor by Powell, just can't afford to do this. Especially after the pressure that was being built. Tamim uses his feet and also makes room. He drives it through covers. Powell there gets around and tries to stop it but it goes between his legs.
Very full on off, Tamim drives it back to the bowler.
Shorter in length outside off, Shakib cuts it to point. A good over by the returning Holder. Just 1 from it.
Off pace delivery on off, Shakib is a touch early into the defense. He gets an outside edge towards point where the fielder makes a good stop.
Takes a step ahead and squeezes it out to point.
Back of a length on off, Shakib defends it onto the ground.
Fuller on middle, Tamim drives it down to long on and gets to the other end. The two have rotated strike brilliantly.
A cutter outside off, Tamim tries to guide it down to third man but misses.
Jason Holder is back on.
Fires it on the pads, the batsman misses the flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Full on middle, Iqbal drives it back to the bowler.
Tucks it to mid-wicket with the angle.
Down the leg side and the umpire signals it a wide.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

On the shorter side on middle, this one pitches, comes slow off the surface and also turns. Tamim is way early into the pull and he gets hit on the pads. There is a muted appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Fires it on middle, Tamim tries to keep it out but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Fires it on off, Shakib punches it to covers.
Full on middle, Tamim strokes it down to long off for a single.
A low full toss on leg stump, Tamim works it to mid-wicket.
Eases this down to long off for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Lovely stuff! Nurse tosses this one up and lands it on off, it pitches and then turns away. Shakib tries to keep it out but is beaten. Windies need one of these to take the outside edge.

Drinks! The visitors are cruising at the moment. They need not do anything expansive, all they have to do is milk the runs and they should get home. For Windies, they need a few quick wickets. Who will get it for them? Holder will hope for someone to raise his hand up and deliver. Will the break work for them? We will find out.
Fires it on off, Shakib cuts it through point for a run. A tidy over by Gayle.
Loopy ball on middle, Shakib drives it back to the bowler.
A single after three dots as Tamim tucks it through mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, TI drives it to covers.
On off again, Tamim hits it to covers.
Starts off with a delivery outside off, Tamim pushes it towards point.
Spin from both ends. Chris Gayle is into the attack.
Floats it up on off, Shakib drives it to mid off.

Darts it on the pads. The batsman clips it towards square leg. They complete a run. The fielder throws it towards the bowler who does not collect it cleanly and an extra run is taken. Can't give away such bonus runs can the Windies.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fires it on off, Tamim pushes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Outside off, turning away further. The batsman lets it be.
Flatter outside off, Tamim guides it to point.
Down the leg side, Tamim works it fine on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Smashed! That made a cracking sound of the bat! Short and on middle, Tamim gets into position early and pulls it through mid-wicket. 100 up for the Windies. Another 172 needed.
A good change in length, a bumper. Tamim ducks under it at the very last moment.
Another slower ball on off, Tamim guides it towards point. They think about a run but then opt against it.
Slower ball on off, Tamim defends it to the man at covers.

Shorter in length on middle, the ball is pulled hard towards the man at deep square leg. The batsmen run through for a single and the fielder there scores a direct hit at the keeper's end. The ball deflects towards covers but there is no overthrow.
Bowls it quick and flat on middle, Shakib works it past mid-wicket and takes a single.
Shout for an lbw, a stifled one though. Nurse dishes out a slider around middle and leg. Shakib hangs back to work it around but misses. They appeal but to no avail. Missing leg.
Flatter and very full on off, Tamim digs it out towards mid on and crosses.
Goes on the back foot to a short ball and cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Quicker one, fired in full outside off, pushed out to short extra cover.
Floated and full on middle, Tamim nurdles it in front of square leg for a run.
Fuller and outside off, Shakib flashes it at, gets it over point and a brace results.
This time he works it through square leg with the angle for a run.

NOT OUT! Too high! A good decision by the umpire. Windies just like their first innings, lose their only review early. Paul bowls it on a length around off, this one pitches and comes back in sharply. Tamim is surprised by it and is late in bringing his bat down. The ball hits Tamim on his pads and goes to the keeper. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. After a chat with his keeper the two convince their skipper to go for the review and Holder does so. Replays roll in and it shows no inside edge but the ball to be bouncing over the stumps.
Review time! The Windies feel they have Tamim trapped in front. Holder goes for the review...
Similar length to the last delivery and line also. Tamim hits it back to the bowler.
Just ahead of a length on middle, Shakib strokes it towards mid on for another single.
Fuller in length on off, Tamim drives it towards wide mid off for a run.
EDGED BUT RUNS! Just outside off, Shakib pokes at it away from his body. He gets an outside edge through short third man for a brace.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Another half-tracker. Tamim punches it through covers for a single.

Short and spinning away. Shakib pulls it off the toe-end through mid-wicket and the batsmen take two. Another 50-run stand comes up between the two left handers. Bangladesh will hope the two continue.
Tosses this up on off, Tamim with the turn drives it to covers.
On the shorter side, Shakib has all the time in the world to go back, tuck it around the corner and take a single.
Fuller again on off, Tamim drives it back to the bowler. A dot to end. So Windies are managing to pull things back a little here but wickets are what they need now.
A little width on offer outside off, Shakib slashes it through point. There is a man in the deep so only a single.
Tight line and length again! On middle, Shakib can only block it onto the ground.
Closer to the off pole this time. Shakib defends it by getting right behind the line.
BEATEN! On a length around off, this one straightens after pitching. Shakib tries to defend it away from the body but misses.
Fuller in length on middle, Shakib drives it back towards the bowler who makes a half stop but no runs conceded.
Powerplay 2 signaled! Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Yes, he can! Tucks it around to mid-wicket with the angle for a dot.
Very short this time and it turns away. Tamim goes back to pull but then seeing it turn away, pulls out of the stroke. Turning out to be another good over by Ashley, can he finish it well?
A little too full on the stumps, the spin is out of contention. Iqbal drives it back to the bowler.
Floats it up on middle, looking for that sharp spin. There ain't any and Tamim defends it easily.
Clips it through the square leg region against the turn for a run.
Flights it up on middle, Shakib keeps it out off the back foot.
It was in the air for a moment but nothing to worry about. Fuller on middle, Tamim flicks it uppishly but well short of mid on. Another decent over, just 5 from it. Only 7 from the last two.
Attacks the stumps and Tamim gets right behind the line and blocks it.

Poor shot! This is slightly on the shorter side outside off and coming in with the angle. Tamim goes for the cut but the ball is too close to play that shot. He misses. He could have easily dragged that on. Should consider himself a touch lucky here.
Changes the angle and cramps Shakib for room by bowling it on his body. The batsman tucks it around the corner and gives the strike over to the centurion of the last game.
FOUR! Follows it up with a poor delivery. Short and wide outside off. Shakib feeds on such deliveries. He cuts it through point and bags another boundary.
Good start by Keemo. On a length and around off, Shakib defends it onto the ground.
Keemo Paul is into the attack.
Slightly short on off, Iqbal goes back and punches it to covers. Just 2 from this over. They need to bowl a few more like this.
BEAUTY! Another one which pitches on off and then turns square. Iqbal lunges to defend but gets beaten. Not a lot you can do on such deliveries. Just hope for it to miss the edge.

Edged and short! What saved Tamim there? The fact that he played with soft hands. Quicker on the off stump. It pitches and turns away. Tamim tries to defend but does not account for the spin. The ball kisses the outside edge and goes on the bounce to Gayle at first slip.
Pitches it on off, Tamim pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker and on the stumps, Shakib has no room to work with. He eases it down to long on and gets to the other end.
A half-tracker on off, this one pitches and turns away. Tamim somehow pulls it down to long on for a run. 200 more needed.
Make that 12 as Tamim works it towards wide mid on for a run. Bangladesh are going at just above 10 per over.
On the pads again, the batsman tucks it around the corner for a run. 11 from the over already.
The two out there are making the wicket look like a belter. Another delivery on middle, Shakib flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.

FOUR! Put away the bad balls and respect the good ones. That is exactly what the Bangladesh batsmen are doing. Another poor delivery, short and wide outside off. What does Shakib do? Something he would do 9 times out of 10. Slaps it through point for another boundary.
Better! Drags his length back and bowls it on a length around off, Shakib keeps it out.
FOUR! Another boundary, 8th of this innings! Full and on off, Shakib shows the full face of the bat and times it exquisitely through mid off. No stopping those.
On the stumps, kept out. So a good comeback by the bowler after going for a boundary on the first ball.
Flatter outside off, Iqbal guides it towards short third man. He wants a run but is rightly sent back by his partner.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
OHHH! Turn and a lot of turn! Flatter and on off, Tamim tries to keep it out off the back foot but the ball pitches and then turns square, beating the outside edge of the bat.
Uses his feet but Nurse sees that. He shortens his length but Tamim does well to defend it.

FOUR! A change in bowler but no change in the pattern. The runs continue to flow. Welcome into the attack Nurse. A short ball and slower in pace. Tamim rocks back, picks the spot where he wants to hit it and strokes it through covers for a boundary.
Spinner introduced early. Ashley Nurse is into the attack.

Another brace! 217 more needed. Runs coming thick and fast. Short and outside off, Shakib once again cuts it over point. This time it is not off the middle and the fielder from third man runs to his left and saves two for his side.
No room offered this time and all Shakib can do is defend it onto the ground.

FOUR! 50 up in no time. Also Shakib crosses 100 runs in this series and he gets a gift to do so. Short and it is pitched half way down the wicket. Shakib says thank you very much as he cuts it over point and the ball races away.
Another fuller ball on middle, Tamim plays it with soft hands towards mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller again but no swing on offer. Tamim drives it to mid on.

Lovely use of the wrists. He does not get a boundary but a brace is also very useful. Full and swinging into the batsman. Tamim plants his front foot forward and flicks it through mid-wicket and runs two.
Another ball down the leg side, Tamim flicks it towards fine leg for a run. 10 from this over and Holder has gone for 30 in his 2.

FOUR! Too much width and Holder pays the price. Short and outside off, Tamim stylishly cuts it through point. It is in the gap and it finds the fence. This is turning out to be another expensive over by Holder.
A little too wide outside off, not wide enough to be signaled one but wide enough to not make the batsman play.
Back of a length on middle, Iqbal works it to mid-wicket.
Shortens his length and the line is also better, outside off. Iqbal punches it to covers.
FOUR! Another inswinger but once again the line is wrong. It is on leg stump. Tamim is too good a batsman to miss out on that. He flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! A big inswinger but the line is down the leg side. Iqbal misses the flick and the umpire signals it a wide.
A misfield and Tamim will retain strike. Fuller on off, Iqbal strokes it towards covers. Holder there misfields and concedes a run.
Shorter in length around off, Iqbal off the back foot, punches it through covers for a couple.
Slightly straighter in line. Shakib works it around the corner and gets off the mark.
Shakib Al Hasan makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! One shot too many and Joseph draws first blood. Haque tries to continue with his attacking approach as he once again gives the charge. Alzarri sticks to bowling length and aims the top of off. Anamul swings blindly and misses the ball by a month. It hits the top of off and ends the entertainment. Joseph also gives him a send-off as Haque walks back dejected. The Windies will now look to pull back things a little.

Good batting! Tamim pushes this towards mid off. The fielder is right at the edge of the circle and the batsmen take one. The southpaw does the right thing as he gives the strike over to Haque who is really giving the Windies bowlers a pounding.

An appeal from the fielders behind the stumps but nothing from the umpire. A length ball around off, slanting away from the batsman. Tamim plays inside the line and lets it be. There is a noise as the ball passes the bat and an appeal follows but the umpire is not interested. The noise was of the bat hitting the pads.

SIX! BANG! Take that, says Haque. Brilliant! He dances down and makes the delivery into a half-volley. He then just tonks it over the long on fence and it has gone a long way. Bangladesh off to a flier. 20 from Jason's first.
In the air and just over! Haque is not holding back here, he is riding his luck. Full delivery on middle, Haque tries to whip it but gets a leading edge which just clears mid on. The batsmen run two.
WIDE! Bowls it outside off, it swings away further. The batsman lets it be and the umpire signals it a wide.

Dew is already setting in. The replays show that Holding lost his footings badly on the previous ball and hence had no control over himself and the ball. Seems to have hurt himself a little bit. The groundstaff comes out and is putting some sawdust near the bowler's landing area.
Holder gets away with a poor delivery. A high full toss outside off and Jason slips in the process as well. Anamul slaps it through the line but finds the point fielder.
SIX! This has gone all the way! Holder overdoes his length. Follows up the last delivery with a shorter one around middle and leg. Anamul picks it early and powers it over fine leg for a biggie.
FOUR! Too hot to handle! An overpitched delivery outside off, Haque latches onto it like a lion on his prey and drills it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
Starts with a length ball around middle and leg, some extra bounce, Tamim nudges it off his pads behind square leg for a run.
Jason Holder to bowl with the second new ball.

FOUR! Anamul is looking in good touch. This time he swivels on the back foot to a shortish ball on middle and pulls it over square leg for a boundary. 11 from the first over, a good start for Bangladesh.
On a length around off, Anamul defends it off his back foot.
Angling away from the batsman, Tamim stays back and hits it square of the wicket on the off side for a run.
FOUR! Edgy! Good length ball on middle and off, Tamim sticks back to defend it but the ball takes the inside edge and hurries past the stumps to the fine leg fence. Would have easily dragged it on.

In the air...just short! A length ball angling down the leg side, Anamul picks it off his pads and whips it across the line. It flies off the inner half of the bat and goes on one bounce to the fine leg fielder. A single taken.
Starts with a back of a length ball around off, not much room, Tamim goes on his toes and plays it down towards third man for a single. Bangladesh are away!

We're back for the chase. The Windies players are on the park. Tamim Iqbal, the centurion of the last game, is all set to open along with Anamul Haque, who got a duck. For the home team, it's going to be Alzarri Joseph to begin proceedings with the first new ball. Here we go...
